messages.author: 58a62321f08f30f8
messages.subject: Predict with occuMulti
parts:
Hi everyone,

First, thanks to Ken and Chris for getting the multi-species model into unmarked - huge!

I'm using the function with two species and now want to make a spatial prediction using all known pixel values. Typically I would pass a data frame to the predict function using 'newdata = ', but when I do this, it throws an error.  Curious if this is just a case of 1) this particular functionality is not yet available, or 2) I'm doing something wrong?

Thanks in advance!

Chris

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: Predict with occuMulti
parts:
Chris,

Thanks. The key thing was the single NA in the non-working data frame (I got confused and thought "all known" meant "no NAs" in your original post). In the current CRAN version there can't  be any NAs in the newdata.

This is partially fixed in this update to the Github version of unmarked, which should at least allow prediction when se.fit=F. I discovered another bug in the process of looking at your issue that causes problems when se.fit=T, but it should be an easy fix. I'll send another PR to Richard, who is surely getting tired of all my little bugfixes!

Thanks for helping me sort out these issues.

Ken
